at1_rows assigns OUTSIDE_TRUST_RADIUS, then OUTSIDE_LINEAR_DDO_REGION, and NGC_NONLINEAR otherwise. It never checks whether u_A+V_I^T c_m leaves the box, although the band polytope includes 0<=u_A+V_I^T c<=1 (A133 s1.5). These category lines are unchanged from v001 (diff and AST).

Pre-existing: v001 alone on my march0 case NEARCORNER, u_A=(0.97,0.03,0.5). There the box rows limit c to +/-0.042 while the trust radius is 0.25. With an exactly linear toy (residual 1.7e-13), 196 of 338 in-box DDO-linear members fail 7864 pairs, all NGC_NONLINEAR, all with c outside the box interval.

findings.title: A boundary in stage 8 (lp/axis) cannot occur under V002 parameters, and the tool would refuse it if it did.
findings.evidence:
In engine c2v003b (L2414-2545), stage 8 catches _BudgetExhausted itself and finalises COMPLETE at stage 'summary'. A budget-B_P1 run whose boundary is an lp/axis call would therefore fail check_snapshot_run and be refused B_P1_WRONG. Under V002, global_design_count is 12, so the post-march global design always comes first at a corner.
I could not build a campaign whose first non-prefix call is in stage 8. With a synthetic global_design_count of 0 at the corner (sigma 1 and 20), the campaign completed with only the 5 prefix calls, and v001 and v002 both refuse REPLAY_UNEXPECTED.

findings.title: The A137 e_q covers only the noise in the FD slope, not the noise in g(u_m) and g(u_A) themselves. This is a spec observation; the code matches A137.
findings.evidence:
g(u_m) - [g(u_A) + K_hat Delta] = curvature + eta(u_m) - eta(u_A) - dK.Delta. e_q bounds only |dK.Delta|. The term |eta(u_m)-eta(u_A)|, up to eps(u_m)+eps(u_A), has no counterpart in AT-1: a_q is the DDO allowance, and it is 0 at the corner.
This only matters for members with |Delta_m,k| much smaller than h_k on rows with near-zero band slack.
findings.label: FORMAL

corrections: N2 claims too much. The lens says that at the corner L5 admits, the band is a single point and every row is NON_DISCRIMINATING. That holds only at corners where the box rows force c = 0, such as m_id = 1 corners (T27, the lens's CORNER_A, my C_00). Counterexample, an m_id = 2 corner that L5 also admits: u_A = (1,0,0.5), V_I = (1,1,+sqrt2)/2 and (1,1,-sqrt2)/2, all four round-0 sides COMPUTATIONAL_BOX_FACE_NO_EVALUATION. v002 snapshot OK (b_p1 5 = oracle) and v001 refuses. The band there is a segment (c1 = -c2): width 0.4424(j+1), from 0.442 to 19.02 km/s, a_q at most 0.83, and 0 of 43 rows NON_DISCRIMINATING; this matches the analytic value 2 x 0.1564 x sqrt2 x (j+1). N2's other line, 'AT-1 can read COVERED only if no member has an identified projection', is true in practice but not strictly: a member passes any row where e_q >= |K_q V_I^T c_m|.

N1 also claims too much where it says the gap applies to 'every failure at the corner that L5 now admits'. At the m_id = 2 corner above, at1 reads SUPERSEDED with 214 failures, all OUTSIDE_TRUST_RADIUS and 0 NGC_NONLINEAR. The wrong label hits failing members that are inside the trust radius and the linear DDO region but whose identified projection leaves the box. At an m_id = 1 corner that is every such failure: my C_00 gave 317 of 317 NGC_NONLINEAR, all box-binding, with a linear toy (residual 7e-14), and T27 gave 316. N1 stays a NOTE. It is reachable from honest producers at such a corner, but the label feeds no value, outcome, tier or score of record. The report also prints the near-zero linearity residuals, which show the label is wrong. This is the same gap the v001 verifier recorded. A root ruling on the A133 s4 category list should come before the first at1.
